description: This file is a server-side route implementation for a SvelteKit application managing invoice product data, including loading product lists and handling create, update, and delete operations with a Django backend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes a list of products from the backend API, applying filters, pagination, and transformation for frontend display.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new product profile via API request.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing product profile via API request.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a product profile via API request.
